SET:F.meaning: frequency agile radars to be suppressed; includes dummy no-task option 0 for task assignment

PARAM:B_m.meaning: working bandwidth of FAR m that must be collectively covered when m is suppressed

PARAM:JSR_nm_k.meaning: jamming-to-signal ratio for UAV n suppressing FAR m at frame k before bandwidth-spreading adjustment

PARAM:JSR0.meaning: reference JSR threshold/scale in the suppressive effect function

PARAM:L.meaning: steepness parameter of the suppressive jamming effect function

PARAM:lambda_cost.meaning: cost factor weighting UAV participation cost

PARAM:uav_far_feasibility.meaning: 1 if UAV n can suppress FAR m at frame k, otherwise 0

PARAM:dynamic_frame_data.meaning: frame-dependent geometry, estimated bandwidth and JSR inputs

VAR:u_nm_k.meaning: 1 if UAV n is assigned to suppress FAR m at frame k; m=0 means no suppression task

VAR:B_nm_k.meaning: bandwidth allocated by UAV n to suppress FAR m at frame k

DERIVED:C_m_k.meaning: UAV coalition suppressing FAR m at frame k

DERIVED:p_nm_k.meaning: suppressive jamming probability/effect of UAV n on FAR m

DERIVED:R(C_m_k,B_m_k).meaning: suppression reward for FAR m at frame k

DERIVED:C(C_m_k).meaning: cost represented by number of UAVs participating in suppressing FAR m

OBJ:OBJ1.meaning: maximize total suppressive jamming utility at a dynamic frame

CON:C1.meaning: each UAV suppresses at most one FAR or chooses the no-task option at a frame

CON:C2.meaning: UAV can only be assigned to feasible FARs

CON:C3.meaning: the coalition bandwidth fully covers FAR m's working bandwidth

CON:C4.meaning: bandwidth is allocated only by UAVs assigned to FAR m and is bounded by FAR bandwidth

SEMANTIC:unsupported_uav_trajectory_path.meaning: UAV trajectory/path planning variables unless provided as exogenous dynamic frame data

SEMANTIC:unsupported_kriging_model_varia.meaning: Kriging model variables or memory module constraints

SEMANTIC:unsupported_planted_task_assign.meaning: planted task assignment or bandwidth allocation in public input

algorithm_boundary: outer GA, Kriging surrogate, memory storage, random immigrants, and inner differential evolution are solution mechanisms; they are not gold formulation constraints
